args.question: What does the cardholder say was not as described or defective, and did they attempt to return the item or contact the merchant?

args.reason: Cardholder says the order never arrived and the merchant has no delivery proof, product description or terms acceptance to contest it.

args.explanation: Visa 13.3 chargeback, 69.43 GBP. Cardholder statement: the order never arrived. The merchant had only a receipt and authorization record, with no delivery proof, product description or terms acceptance, so I accepted liability. Outcome: lost (accepted). Ledger shows merchant net -16.27 USD after the sale reversal, FX difference and the 15.00 USD chargeback fee.
